formality.titleDefault: As before — no formality parameter is sent to DeepL
formality.titleActive: DeepL translates using the selected form of address

formality.partialNoEffect: No effect for {{langs}} — DeepL offers no formality setting there. The other target languages will get it.

neutral.label: Translate neutrally (no glossary)
neutral.title: Translates purely via DeepL without glossary or channel terms — e.g. for comparison runs or free texts.

formatProfile.label: Format profile
formatProfile.title: The profile determines which columns/fields are translated and which remain untouched (header, technical values, Magento constants)
formatProfile.help: Magento profiles protect columns such as <c>page_layout</c>, <c>identifier</c>, and constants such as <c>1column</c> and <c>inner</c> from translation. HTML columns such as <c>content</c> run in DeepL HTML mode.

storeView.info: Internal links are automatically set to the store view of the target language.
storeView.detail: — image, media and resource paths (<c>src</c>, <c>srcset</c>, CSS/JS, PDFs, downloads) remain unchanged, as do external links and <c>{{directive}}</c> directives.

optimize.label: Optimise source text before translation
optimize.title: Checks every source text section with LanguageTool and automatically applies safe corrections (typos, typography, punctuation). Style suggestions are NOT applied.

drop.formats: IDML, DOCX, XLSX, PDF, XML, HTML, TXT, CSV, MD (max. 100 MB)

errors.targetIsSource: Target languages must not include the source language

upload.channelFassungHint: German → German rewrites the document into the selected channel’s version (house style) — DeepL is not used for this.

consistency.title: Consistency check
consistency.subtitle: Find identical source texts with differing translations
consistency.help: Groups by normalised source texts (tolerant of whitespace and quotes). Shows only entries where one and the same source text has more than one translation in the cache — an indicator of inconsistent reviews or unclear glossary rules.
